Mr. Shrirang Shashishekhar Dande, Advocate for the Petitioner  Mr. R. B. Dhaware, AGP for the Respondents - State  Mr. A. G. Sakolkar, Advocate for Respondent Nos.4 to 21  .....
 CORAM : SIDDHESHWAR S. THOMBRE, J.
 DATE : 07.03.2026

PER COURT :
1. Heard the learned Counsel for the respective parties for some time.

2. In the midst of the hearing, it was brought to my notice by the learned Counsel Mr. Dande that the Respondents - Claimants have already filed reference under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short 'the said Act') and the same is pending.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013

sentences.text: The Petitioner has also filed a written statement therein.
Therefore, without going into the merits of the matters, I am inclined to dispose of the writ petitions by maintaining the order passed by the District Collector, Latur.
